question: At the 2025 Kalinga Literary Festival, Professor Arunava Sinha won an award for his translation of stories by?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandipan Chattopadhyay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kalinga Literary Festival (KLF) 2025**, held in **Bhubaneswar**, **Odisha**, honored Professor **Arunava Sinha** for his outstanding contributions to the field of **literary translation**.
 
• Professor **Arunava Sinha** won the prestigious award for his **English translation** of the collected stories of the eminent **Bengali** writer **Sandipan Chattopadhyay**.
 
• **Sandipan Chattopadhyay** was a trailblazing figure in modern **Bengali literature**, celebrated for his experimental style and profound exploration of the human psyche.
 
• The award recognizes **Arunava Sinha's** role in making regional masterpieces accessible to a **global audience**, bridging the linguistic gap between **Bengali** and **English** readers.
